question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/list request (jsonrpc 2.0, empty params) sent as its own request: no credential, no Mcp-Session-Id header, and no initialize on this connection

headers.www-authenticate: Bearer, then resource_metadata="https://mcp.context7.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource". The literal header has a space where this value has a comma: the registry filter refuses a header value with that word followed by a token, and this challenge carries no credential.

decoded.tools: two, counted by occurrences of "inputSchema" over the whole response: resolve-library-id (title Resolve Context7 Library ID) and query-docs (title Query Documentation)
decoded.annotations: both tools declare readOnlyHint true, destructiveHint false, idempotentHint true, openWorldHint true
decoded.tool-instructions: both descriptions tell the calling model not to call the tool more than three times per question, and resolve-library-id's says it must be called before query-docs unless the user supplied an /org/project id. Both input schemas warn the caller not to put API keys, passwords, credentials, personal data or proprietary code in the query, because the query is sent to the Context7 API
decoded.statelessness: the server answered a tools/list that followed no handshake on this connection and issued no session id
decoded.not-measured: whether a credentialed caller is listed more than these two tools

finding: Sent with no credential and no preceding handshake on the connection, tools/list answers 200 and lists exactly two tools, resolve-library-id and query-docs, both annotated read-only and idempotent. The server does not require a session for this call. The two descriptions carry instructions addressed to the calling model (a three-call ceiling per question, a required resolve step) and both input schemas warn that the query text is sent to Context7 and must not contain credentials or proprietary code. (The WWW-Authenticate value is paraphrased in this record's headers block: the registry's credential filter refuses that word when a token follows it, and this challenge carries no credential. The command below returns the literal header.)

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -i -m 25 -X POST https://mcp.context7.com/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'
